span.p:
pc reg, 8 bits
rst → 0
pc_en → pc_jmp ? operand : pc + 1

imem ROM
N × 16 bits
word = imem[pc]

span.p:
decode
opcode = word[15:13]
delay = word[12:8]
operand = word[7:0]

span.p:
tx_fifo
8 bits × depth
tx_push → append
pull_en → drop head

span.p:
shift_reg reg, 8 bits
rst → 0
pull_en → fifo_head
shift_en → {1'b0, shift_reg[7:1]}

span.p:
gpio reg, 4 bits
rst → 4'b1111
gpio_en → gpio[idx] ← bit
bit = gpio_sel ? shift_reg[0] : operand[0]
idx = gpio_sel ? 0 : operand[5:4]
